The vacuum bottles provide insulation between the live parts of the switchgear and the grounded metal enclosure, preventing the flow of current and ensuring safety.
2. Circuit breaker: The circuit breaker is an electrical switch that can open and close a circuit under normal and abnormal conditions. 7. Insulation: Insulation is used to prevent the flow of current between live parts and grounded parts. The insulation is typically made of paper or oil-impregnated pressboard and is designed to withstand high voltages and temperatures.
